name: ELIX Center
description: AI Agent Cockpit, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server matrix, execution trace observability visualizers, and vector memory telemetry deck

list_active_agents.name: list_active_agents
list_active_agents.description: Query running, idle, and paused autonomous agent processes with execution states and token telemetry

spawn_agent_run.name: spawn_agent_run
spawn_agent_run.description: Launch a new background or foreground autonomous agent run with assigned model and MCP tool capabilities

assignedModel.description: LLM model identifier, e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet, gpt-4o, gemini-1.5-pro

enabledMcpServers.description: List of MCP server IDs to attach

maxBudgetTokens.description: Maximum token budget before triggering approval halt

query_mcp_servers.name: query_mcp_servers
query_mcp_servers.description: Discover connected Model Context Protocol servers, active tool schemas, and connection health states

includeSchemas.description: Whether to return full JSON-RPC tool schemas

healthCheck.description: Perform live heartbeat check against child processes

toggle_mcp_server.name: toggle_mcp_server
toggle_mcp_server.description: Start, stop, restart, or trigger exponential reconnect on a target MCP server daemon

inspect_memory_vectors.name: inspect_memory_vectors
inspect_memory_vectors.description: Search and inspect embedding vectors and semantic memory chunks stored in ELIX Memory Store

collectionName.description: Vector collection name, e.g. code_base, session_history

topK.description: Number of nearest neighbors to retrieve

get_token_telemetry.name: get_token_telemetry
get_token_telemetry.description: Retrieve token consumption metrics, burn rates, and financial cost breakdowns

groupBy.description: Dimension to group token consumption by
